summary: The repository documents its completed nine-stage Automata integration separately from generic package extraction. Independent models, defect controls and seven controlled runtime fault schedules are implemented examples; Automata0.5.0 is not a public FsQuint dependency. Native provider qualification is opt-in/nonpackable: pinned upstream SQLite118 and PostgreSQL152 tests plus public-API killed-worker recovery and one PostgreSQL corrected-history restart witness. SQLite temporal correction is explicitly unsupported, not equivalent to PostgreSQL. Historical local evidence and fresh scheduled CI are distinct. No arbitrary-history correctness, replica/failover coverage, exactly-once external effects or throughput SLO follows. Chart exporters, finite callback exploration, shared IR and historical trace validation remain explicitly deferred until a named consumer/data contract and maintenance owner exist; a new audit must not reopen completed stages or claim these deferrals implemented.
title: Automata examples retain bounded native provider evidence
